title: Directory of BIS Central, Regional, and Recognized External Testing Laboratories
scope: This document contains the official structured list of 15 BIS Central, Regional, and Recognized Independent Testing Laboratories across India operating under the BIS Laboratory Recognition Scheme (LRS) to perform conformity testing for ISI Marking (Scheme I) and Compulsory Registration (Scheme II — CRS).
description: BIS operates a robust network of internal central/regional laboratories alongside external third-party testing laboratories recognized under the BIS Laboratory Recognition Scheme (LRS) 2020. To obtain BIS recognition, external labs must hold valid NABL accreditation under ISO/IEC 17025 in relevant technical disciplines (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Electronics, Microbiological) and pass mandatory proficiency testing (PT). This directory lists 15 key recognized testing facilities across India with details on region, location, primary category, and primary standards tested.

key_requirements.requirement: Laboratory must hold valid NABL accreditation as per ISO/IEC 17025 for the specific Indian Standards applied for.
Mandatory satisfactory participation in Inter-Laboratory Comparison (ILC) / PT programs organized by BIS or NABL.

sections.title: Laboratory Recognition Scheme (LRS) 2020 Framework
sections.content: BIS grants recognition to outside laboratories under Section 13 of the BIS Act 2016 and LRS Guidelines 2020 to augment testing capacity for Product Certification (ISI Mark) and Compulsory Registration (CRS). Recognized labs perform initial sample testing, surveillance sample testing, and referee testing.

sections.title: Recognition Criteria & Discipline Scope
sections.content: Labs are evaluated based on testing equipment, calibration traceability, technical competence of personnel, environmental controls, and sample security. Recognition is granted for specific Indian Standards for 3 years, renewable upon audit.
